title: AW27 Men's Elegant Layers
summary: Layering at the neck and refined detail: turtleneck, shirt, waistcoat and jacket, fur or hairy collars, leather as a detail.
research_period: Pitti Filati, June 2026; Première Vision, Lineapelle and Milano Unica, September 2026; forecaster reports to November 2026

sections.heading: How this forecast was built
sections.body: Pre-runway forecast. The AW27 shows run from January to March 2027. This report is built from the 2026 yarn, fabric and leather fairs (Pitti Filati in June; Première Vision, Lineapelle and Milano Unica in September), published forecaster views and the SS27 runways. Forecut will update it after the shows.

sections.heading: The story
sections.body: Van den Hoek sees layering at the neck (turtleneck, shirt, waistcoat, jacket), fur or hairy collars and leather moving into details: a collar, a shirt, a patch pocket <sup>[1]</sup>. Agelink describes "layering by construction", such as Prada's shirt under jacket <sup>[2]</sup>.

sections.heading: Silhouettes
sections.body:
- Waistcoat with jacket.
- Turtleneck under a shirt.
- Leather-collared coat.

sections.heading: Trims and details
sections.body: Leather collars and patch pockets, horn buttons.
